plan.title: SRC-CRE-040 — Reject product not in catalogue

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Choose the available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is rendered.
Add the mapped catalogue product and establish the sheet row used by the case.
Enter the requested quantity from the scenario.
Search the Product dropdown for the nonexistent product; the step records that no matching option is offered.
Assert that the invalid product is not retained and the product cell remains empty.
